special_doors.name: 机关门
special_doors.raw_script:
x1=7;y1=7;x2=7;y2=7;@sw=true
for y in y1...y2+1
for x in x1...x2+1
if $game_map.have_an_event?(x,y)
@iid=$game_map.check_event(x,y)
if $game_map.events[@iid]\
.event.name[0,6]=="怪物"
@sw=false;break
end
end
end
end
